independent_reference: Microsoft NamedPipeServerStream.RunAsClient examples read client message before impersonation; named pipe security descriptors require native readback and effective-token verification.
security_findings: Installed V1 EXE invokes RunAsClient before receiving the client message. This is a protocol attestation defect; don't start V1 as native security-qualified.
V1 worker probe checks combined rights only, where ACCESS_DENIED can be caused by one right; V2 independently tests individual write-capable rights and ledger GENERIC_WRITE denial.
V2 sources and compiler runner are candidates until Windows native compilation succeeds.
No Windows service binary path modification/start, worker logon test, DACL readback, W01-W12 or grouped QA has occurred in this source-preflight.
